say:1:1711021001:1.text: I heard Cassadee's in trouble, so I came as fast as I could!
say:1:1711021001:1.source_cn: 听说科丝蒂遇到了大麻烦，我就马不停蹄地赶来了！

say:2:1711021002:1.text: Magister Merlin, you're here too! Looks like they roped you into helping again.
say:2:1711021002:1.source_cn: 梅林大人，您也在啊。看来他们又把您抓过来解围了。
say:2:1711021002:1.male: Magister Merlin, you're here too! Looks like they roped you into helping again.
say:2:1711021002:1.female: Magister Merlin, you're here too! Looks like they roped you into helping again.

choice_prompt:3:1711021002.text: Magister Merlin, you're here too! Looks like they roped you into helping again.
choice_prompt:3:1711021002.source_cn: 梅林大人，您也在啊。看来他们又把您抓过来解围了。
choice_prompt:3:1711021002.male: Magister Merlin, you're here too! Looks like they roped you into helping again.
choice_prompt:3:1711021002.female: Magister Merlin, you're here too! Looks like they roped you into helping again.

say:4:1711021003:1.text: I'm really glad to see you, even more than seeing Envoy Evie.
say:4:1711021003:1.source_cn: 见到您真高兴，比见到伊芙大人开心多了。
say:4:1711021003:1.male: I'm really glad to see you, even more than seeing Envoy Evie.
say:4:1711021003:1.female: I'm really glad to see you, even more than seeing Envoy Evie.

say:5:1711021004:1.text: Lately, she's summoned me so often I've seen her more than my own parents...
say:5:1711021004:1.source_cn: 说实话，这段时间我被伊芙大人传唤的次数，比我回家见父母...
say:5:1711021004:1.male: Lately, she's summoned me so often I've seen her more than my own parents...
say:5:1711021004:1.female: Lately, she's summoned me so often I've seen her more than my own parents...

say:6:1711021005:1.text: I thought this could be another issue about Gervan, but she said Cassadee was in trouble.
say:6:1711021005:1.source_cn: 本以为这次还是与格墨文相关的案情调查，结果伊芙大人说，...
say:6:1711021005:1.male: I thought this could be another issue about Gervan, but she said Cassadee was in trouble.
say:6:1711021005:1.female: I thought this could be another issue about Gervan, but she said Cassadee was in trouble.

say:8:1711021006:1.text: So you're the apprentice mage they sent?
say:8:1711021006:1.source_cn: 所以你就是来帮忙的见习魔法师！

say:9:1711021007:1.text: Heh, that's me! Envoy Evie even tried to lure me in with a generous hourly rate. But I told her she was underestimating me! When friends need help, a knight doesn't ask about pay!
say:9:1711021007:1.source_cn: 嘿嘿，是我。伊芙大人还试图用高额时薪来诱惑我。 但我告...

choice_prompt:10:1711021007.text: Heh, that's me! Envoy Evie even tried to lure me in with a generous hourly rate. But I told her she was underestimating me! When friends need help, a knight doesn't ask about pay!
choice_prompt:10:1711021007.source_cn: 嘿嘿，是我。伊芙大人还试图用高额时薪来诱惑我。 但我告诉她，这太小看我了！当朋友和耀光需要帮助时，骑士绝不会先问报酬！

say:11:1711021008:1.text: That's just a knight's basic code!
say:11:1711021008:1.male: That's just a knight's basic code!
say:11:1711021008:1.female: That's just a knight's basic code!

say:12:1711021011:1.text: I'm surprised you made it so fast. I thought the process would take days.
say:12:1711021011:1.source_cn: 真没想到你来得这么快，我还以为流程需要走几天。

say:13:1711021012:1.text: I would've been here sooner, but I had to sign a gigantic stack of confidentiality agreements. My hands were aching after that...
say:13:1711021012:1.source_cn: 我本可以来得更早，但是，要接下这份差事，得先签订比马还...

choice_prompt:14:1711021012.text: I would've been here sooner, but I had to sign a gigantic stack of confidentiality agreements. My hands were aching after that...
choice_prompt:14:1711021012.source_cn: 我本可以来得更早，但是，要接下这份差事，得先签订比马还高的一大摞保密协议，所以耽误了时间。

say:15:1711021013:1.text: Don't worry. Even if it's just sorting documents, I'll tackle it with the same spirit as charging into battle!
say:15:1711021013:1.source_cn: 放心吧， 哪怕只是整理文件和盖章，我也会拿出在战场冲锋...
say:15:1711021013:1.male: Don't worry. Even if it's just sorting documents, I'll tackle it with the same spirit as charging into battle!
say:15:1711021013:1.female: Don't worry. Even if it's just sorting documents, I'll tackle it with the same spirit as charging into battle!

choice_prompt:16:1711021013.text: Don't worry. Even if it's just sorting documents, I'll tackle it with the same spirit as charging into battle!
choice_prompt:16:1711021013.source_cn: 放心吧， 哪怕只是整理文件和盖章，我也会拿出在战场冲锋的气势来完成！
choice_prompt:16:1711021013.male: Don't worry. Even if it's just sorting documents, I'll tackle it with the same spirit as charging into battle!
choice_prompt:16:1711021013.female: Don't worry. Even if it's just sorting documents, I'll tackle it with the same spirit as charging into battle!

say:17:1711021014:1.text: We'll stay out here. Just call if you need anything!
say:17:1711021014:1.source_cn: 我们就在外面，有事请随时叫我！
say:17:1711021014:1.male: We'll stay out here. Just call if you need anything!
say:17:1711021014:1.female: We'll stay out here. Just call if you need anything!

choice:16:0:1.source_cn: 那我就去搜查迪尔格雷的办公室

choice:14:0:1.text: I'll leave things here to you.
choice:14:0:1.source_cn: 接下来的工作就交给你了
choice:14:0:1.male: I'll leave things here to you.
choice:14:0:1.female: I'll leave things here to you.

say:19:1711021009:1.text: Haha! If it's for you, I'd hand it all over!
say:19:1711021009:1.source_cn: 哈哈！如果是梅林大人需要，那我愿意全额奉上！
say:19:1711021009:1.male: Haha! If it's for you, I'd hand it all over!
say:19:1711021009:1.female: Haha! If it's for you, I'd hand it all over!

say:20:1711021010:1.text: Besides, with how expensive the capital is, that pay would barely cover a few bags of apples.
say:20:1711021010:1.source_cn: 反正那点薪水在王都的物价面前，大概也只够买几袋苹果。
say:20:1711021010:1.male: Besides, with how expensive the capital is, that pay would barely cover a few bags of apples.
say:20:1711021010:1.female: Besides, with how expensive the capital is, that pay would barely cover a few bags of apples.

choice:10:1:2.text: If you don't want the money, I'll take it.
choice:10:1:2.male: If you don't want the money, I'll take it.
choice:10:1:2.female: If you don't want the money, I'll take it.
